verdict.rationale: Snowflake exposes developer-facing surfaces relevant to AI-native/agentic building — a scriptable, headless CLI (snow sql supports piping/inline queries for scripted agents) and an official Cortex MCP server that lets agents call Cortex Analyst/Search/Agents and custom tools/SQL — plus Snowpark as a programmatic dev framework mentioned in CLI docs. However, the evidence pack never surfaces a dedicated 'official SDK' page (e.g., Python/Java/REST client library docs) that an AI-native builder would target directly. Missing for 10: explicit official SDK/client-library documentation (Python connector, REST API, Java/Node SDKs), and independent hands-on confirmation that agents build successfully against these SDKs beyond the CLI/MCP probes.
